title: S4 step-rail — an ordered process on one horizontal connector
idea: An ordered process laid across the band on one continuous connector, so the sequence is visible before a word is read. The line through the numerals is the composition.
why_new: the index item pattern numbers stacked rows, but the numbers sit in a scan column with nothing joining them, and the order runs down rather than across. This is also the only archetype that earns device--section-numeral, which has no home today.
built_from: one wp:columns of four, plus one CSS hook for the connector in ScaffoldThemeStep.
risk: it overlaps the index item pattern, so a site committed to index would carry both idioms. Decide which one owns ordered content before building. The connector must disappear when the steps stack, or it becomes a stray horizontal rule.
